protocol.population: 24 shipped catalog teams drawn independently by normalized drawWeight; shipped blind prior
protocol.information: defenders blind; attacker true state is a deliberately stronger stress test, same for oracle and control
protocol.policy: exact live search lifecycle, UCB c=0.4 buckets=16; no baked/compiled previews; all decisions including preview use requested mode
protocol.oracle: three independent persistent target-model seeds, never live target seed; root distribution only; deeper attacker UCB; approximate BR, not exact exploitability
protocol.control: same attacker search/rollout and own 243000 iterations, oracle disabled; total compute differs by three target searches
protocol.schedule: same teams, chance seeds and physical-side agent seeds across cells; both target sides per block; pilot seeds disjoint
protocol.primary: each candidate vs legacy: W/D/L and mean score, block-bootstrap confidence interval; against tailored oracle: paired target-score difference vs legacy, same blocks
protocol.secondary: paired pure-win difference; oracle-vs-control target score loss on common first 32 blocks; preview/battle mixing activation, legacy disagreement, latency, terminal coverage
protocol.inference: 100000 block-bootstrap draws fixed seed 202610170303; 98.75% two-sided intervals for four primary contrasts (Bonferroni family 95%); other intervals descriptive 95%; block is unit
protocol.criterion: direct improvement: score-minus-0.5 interval lower >0; resistance improvement: oracle defender-score difference interval lower >0. Report pure-win estimates separately. Broad promotion requires both, no claim from significance in only one.
protocol.stopping: fixed 128 pairs direct per candidate, 64 pairs oracle per defender, 32 pairs control per defender, 4 legacy-null pairs. No outcome-driven stopping or parameter selection. Pilot for timing and correctness only.
protocol.caps: engine turn-1000 draw rule; operational max_turns=1001; any nonterminal cap reported as unresolved and bounded, not silently drawn
protocol.scope: live research path, not deployed compiled-preview behavior or formal Nash exploitability
